summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) with --chain flag, executing the full research → pattern-mapping → planning → verification pipeline.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans across 2 waves were created, committed, and verified by the plan checker with 0 blockers and 1 cosmetic warning (resolved inline). ROADMAP updated to 0/4, VALIDATION.md written, PATTERNS.md generated.

repo: Phase 58 is a backend crypto/security coverage phase with TDD mode on, fine granularity, 4 plans, 2 waves, and locked decisions D-01..D-13.
The crates/crypto crate cannot dev-depend on api-client or core crates, so Rust vector consumer tests must live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/ to avoid dependency cycles.
The GSD workflow's commit helper returns commit_failed as a known false-negative; always verify with git log rather than retrying the commit.
ASVS L1 security gate requires each PLAN.md to include a <threat_model> block; high-severity threats are blockers.
Pattern mapper (gsd-pattern-mapper subagent) classifies relevant source files into PATTERNS.md before the planner runs; 14 files were classified for phase 58.

The plan checker flagged RESEARCH.md's '## Open Questions' heading for lacking a '(RESOLVED)' marker, even though all questions were substantively handled in-plan — a doc-convention check, not a content check.
workflow: In --chain (auto-advance) mode with no existing RESEARCH.md, the orchestrator spawns the researcher automatically without prompting.
The correction-without-replanning loop pattern: fix a cosmetic doc warning by editing RESEARCH.md directly rather than re-spawning the planner, saving significant token cost.
UI gate and schema-push gate are skipped when the phase has no frontend or ORM changes respectively.
VALIDATION.md frontmatter is written by the orchestrator; the body scaffold is owned by execute/validate tooling and should not be pre-filled.

friction: commit helper reported commit_failed (known false-negative) requiring a secondary git log verification step to confirm the commit actually landed.
RESEARCH.md '## Open Questions' heading cosmetic warning from plan checker — a doc-convention mismatch that required a manual edit fix outside the normal planner loop.
open_items: ROADMAP shows 0/4 plans complete — phase 58 execution (waves 1 and 2) has not started yet.
Cargo.lock has a pre-existing modification that was noted but left untouched throughout the session.
